topic: Review finds a problem's line by parsing orchd's message
detail: SpacesProblem carries rule, space and message. The app places each problem on its line from the rule and the value the message quotes (Go %q), or the public_paths entry number; a reworded message makes the problem unplaced (shown apart, Apply still blocked, so it fails safe). Add the field and value index to SpacesProblem (orchd.proto change) and use them.
